description: Percentile summaries of a Monte Carlo statement-model evaluation.

forecast_periods.description: Forecast (non-actual) periods included in the simulation.

incomplete.description:
Why no statistics were published, when a requested sample had no
value on some path. `None` for a complete run.

n_paths.description: Number of Monte Carlo paths simulated.

path_data.description: Optional full path data in long-format table form.

percentile_results.description:
Aggregated percentile results: `metric → PercentileSeries`, in the
requested metric order. Empty when the run is incomplete.

provenance.description: Identified model, observation cut and valuation date for every retained path.

seed.description:
The run's exact base seed, a decimal string in JSON: an unsigned
64-bit value does not fit a JavaScript number.

stream_version.description:
Version of the mapping from the seed, path and node to a random
stream. With the seed it replays any path from the result alone.

warnings.description:
Distinct warnings raised in the simulated forecast periods, each
reported once however many paths raised it, in a canonical sorted
order. Warnings in actual periods are omitted: those periods are not
simulated and every path repeats the deterministic evaluation's.

title: MonteCarloResults

d_0764b89834ca123e9b7c.description:
Node value type classification.

Determines whether a node represents monetary values (with a specific currency)
or scalar values (ratios, percentages, counts, etc.).

oneOf.description: Monetary value with a specific currency (e.g., revenue, costs, balance sheet items)
Unitless scalar value (e.g., ratios, percentages, counts)

d_090e21e61cdf3e0563e2.description: Column storage variants supported by the table envelope.

d_25c2be0082c34cc8d8f4.description:
Replay provenance of one stochastic forecast node in a single run.

The generator is the shared PCG64 started at `state` on stream `stream`
(`Pcg64Rng::new_with_stream(state, stream)`). Both are derived from the
versioned key: the key version, the configured seed, the node and the
single-run mode. Unsigned 64-bit values are decimal strings in JSON.

seed.description: The forecast method's exact configured seed.

stream_version.description: Version of the mapping from the key to the stream.

d_2f3bf3b3f13fb41b2ca2.description: A single named column in a [`TableEnvelope`].

role.description: Optional semantic hint for bindings and consumers.

d_2f44e69fe77b00d952fa.description: Sentinel string the [`non_finite_f64`] adapter writes for a non-finite `f64`.

d_46e9b9f749a497bf5bc2.description:
What a result was evaluated from.

A consumer that is handed a result checks this against the model, period
plan and run it expects before trusting the cells.

forecast_streams.description:
The random stream of every stochastic forecast node in a single run,
in model node order: enough to replay its draws.

model_content_hash.description:
Canonical content hash of the evaluated model
([`FinancialModelSpec::content_hash`](crate::types::FinancialModelSpec::content_hash)).

observation_cutoff.description: Observations the run was allowed to read.

run_id.description:
Identity of this evaluation run: the canonical content hash of the
fields above. Two runs of the same model content, snapshot, cutoff
and valuation date share it.

source_snapshot.description: Identity of the source snapshot the model's observations came from.

valuation_date.description:
Valuation date the capital structure was priced at, when the run used
a market.

d_6dbdf0cc2ba8afa48229.description:
Why a Monte Carlo run published no statistics.

A run is complete only when every path has a value for every requested
metric in every forecast period.

metric.description: First metric, in the requested order, with a sample without a value.

missing_samples.description: Number of samples without a value across the run.

path.description: Lowest path with such a sample for that metric and period.

period.description: First forecast period of that metric with such a sample.

reason.description:
Why that cell had no value: `missing`, `masked`, or the reason an
unavailable cell gives (for example `missing_peer_shock`).

d_6ebc05ff50e5cef14048.description: ISO 8601 calendar date encoded as a `YYYY-MM-DD` JSON string.

d_797699a3f0493b0ba6f3.description: Typed reason for a capital-structure evaluation warning.

oneOf.description: A negative available-cash pool was floored to zero before allocation.

amount.description: Negative amount that was floored, in the waterfall currency.

node_id.description: Statement node supplying the available-cash amount.

oneOf.description: Available cash was insufficient to pay a cash-interest claim.

amount.description: Unpaid amount in the waterfall currency.

instrument_id.description: Instrument carrying the unpaid claim forward.

oneOf.description: Available cash was insufficient to pay a fee claim.

amount.description: Unpaid amount in the waterfall currency.

instrument_id.description: Instrument carrying the unpaid claim forward.

oneOf.description: Available cash was insufficient to pay scheduled principal.

amount.description: Unpaid amount in the waterfall currency.

instrument_id.description: Instrument carrying the unpaid claim forward.

d_9c2fac7fef3fb26aaf21.description: Optional semantic hint for a column.

oneOf.description: Row identifier or primary grouping field.

sample_count.description: Number of samples behind each quantile: the path count.

value_type.description: Units of every value: scalar, or money in one currency.

values.description:
Period → `(probability, value)` pairs in ascending probability. The
value is the R-7 sample quantile, in `value_type` units.

anyOf.description: A finite value, written as a JSON number.
A non-finite value, written as its sentinel string.

d_a176fd07772b7dfa6e59.description:
An `f64` in the [`non_finite_f64`] wire form: a JSON number when finite,
otherwise one of the strings `"inf"`, `"-inf"` or `"nan"`.

Contract types store plain `f64` fields with
`#[serde(with = "finstack_quant_core::wire::non_finite_f64")]` and name this
type in `#[schemars(with = ...)]`, so the generated schema describes the
sentinel strings the serializer actually writes.

d_a9ef2bc562ba1ce16d9d.description:
Which explicit observations an evaluation may read.

On the wire: `"full_snapshot"`, or `{"through": "2025-04-25"}`.

oneOf.description:
Read every observation in the model's snapshot, with no publication
cutoff.

Read an observation only when its availability date is on or before
this date, inclusive through the end of the day.

d_b888a5be75073df7b251.description:
Identifier for a Gregorian period like `2025Q1` or a fiscal period like
`FY2025W53`.

d_ce059e1e5fd8531c74da.description:
Serializable columnar table envelope.

Tables preserve column order and validate that every column has the same row
count. Optional metadata can record domain-specific hints such as which
column is a metric, what a numeric field represents, or how a host-language
binding should interpret the data.

metadata.description: Table-level metadata for downstream bindings and documentation.

row_count.description: Number of rows in the table.

oneOf.description:
A percentage change or growth rate was measured from a zero base, so
its cell is unavailable. A division by zero in a formula is an error,
not this warning.

node_id.description: Identifier of the node that triggered the warning.

period.description: Period in which the warning occurred.

oneOf.description:
Non-finite value (NaN, Inf, -Inf) detected when storing a node result.

This warning is emitted by the finiteness validation pipeline so that
consumers can identify which node/period introduced bad values.

node_id.description: Identifier of the node that produced the non-finite value.

period.description: Period in which the warning occurred.

value.description: The actual non-finite value, encoded as `"nan"`, `"inf"`, or `"-inf"`.

oneOf.description: Capital-structure extraction or waterfall processing required a guarded fallback.

period.description: Period in which the warning was raised.

warning.description: Typed reason and associated diagnostic values.

oneOf.description:
A forecast's published level was clipped to its `min` / `max` bound.
The raw level still drives the forecast's later steps.

period.description: Period whose published level was clipped.

published.description: Level published after the bound, in the node's units.

raw.description: Level the forecast generated, in the node's units.

oneOf.description:
A full-history statistic (`std`, `var`, `median`) was computed over a
history with gaps, so its sample is smaller than its slot count.

node_id.description: Identifier of the node whose statistic has gaps.

period.description: Period the statistic was computed for.

slots.description: Plan slots from the model start through the period.
